# HELP monitor_status Monitor Status (1 = UP, 0 = DOWN, 2 = PENDING, 3 = MAINTENANCE)
# TYPE monitor_status gauge

monitor_status{monitor_name="Роутер",monitor_type="http",monitor_url="https://example.test",monitor_hostname="null",monitor_port="null"} 1
